design_system.name: PERSOFEST'26 Neobrutalism
design_system.description: A high-contrast, raw, and energetic design system for a college event portal.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text on colored backgrounds is pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) depending on brightness. Avoid grey text.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus rings must be 2px solid black with offset.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Neobrutalism' aesthetic strictly. No soft shadows, no rounded corners > 4px.
Use 'Lexend Mega' for all headings to give a bold, poster-like feel.
Use 'Space Mono' for all body text and form inputs to give a technical/raw feel.
All containers (cards, sections, images) must have a 2px or 4px solid black border.
Buttons must have a hard shadow that moves on hover (translate effect).
Use the provided image URLs for the landing page hero and background textures.
The sidebar navigation should be a fixed column with thick borders and bold, uppercase links.
Forms should feel like 'paper' forms - distinct sections, clear labels, high contrast inputs.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or the provided abstract shape images as textures.
Ensure the 'Profile Dashboard' uses a grid layout (Bento grid style) with thick black dividers.
